workflow.title: Uninstalling a Mac app is not the same as investigating storage growth
workflow.primaryIntent: Decide whether a known unwanted app or an unexplained storage trend is the problem before choosing a maintenance tool.
outline: Start with the decision: remove a known app versus investigate an unexplained change.
Show the official AppCleaner visual immediately after the lead once rights clear.
Explain only the documented drop-app, related-files, delete-button sequence; no invented screenshots, exact clicks or test outcomes.
Review data you may want to keep before authorising deletion; do not infer file ownership or disposability from size.
Use the labeled Breathing Room Space preview to illustrate investigation, not uninstall parity or measured recovery.
Explain release, Python, account/hosted AI and pricing caveats at the single disclosed recommendation.
End with a decision checklist and links to comparison/hub.
workflow.distinctFromComparison: Problem diagnosis and app-removal versus growth-investigation decision, not a long feature-matrix rewrite.
workflow.interactionPass: A non-executing decision checklist: known app to remove / unexplained disk growth / need vendor-specific removal guidance. No filesystem access, cleanup button or forced code demo.
